mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate directly lowers the risk-free rate used in equity discounting models, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as valuation multiples expand.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS level and 20-day forward returns remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market health, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises >0.5pp quarterly, 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and accommodative policy (FEDFUNDS < 4.0%) triggers market anticipation of aggressive rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) yields negative Rank IC < -0.03 in 20-day forward returns during trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion regimes, housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1,300,000 units signal robust consumer confidence and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In early-cycle expansion, when HOUST >1300, 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above 100 indicates expanding manufacturing output, boosting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO level and 5-day forward returns remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) below 1.5% signals economic contraction, reducing corporate profit expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When quarterly GDP growth rate <1.5%, 60-day forward returns are positive in >55% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive policy to curb inflation, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, when FEDFUNDS >4.5%, 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising housing starts (HOUST > 1300) and industrial production (INDPRO > 100) signals synchronized demand-supply expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * INDPRO) yields positive Rank IC < 0.03 in 20-day forward returns during trigger condition.
